latest_final: A man being sought by law enforcement hid inside a coffin to evade capture. He knew the coffin contained someone who had died, and that deceased acquaintance had arranged the hiding place and promised to dig him out after the burial. The man expected his friend to be alive to carry out the rescue. The friend died unexpectedly before the funeral, and no one else knew the man was in the coffin and intended to dig him up. During the funeral, the coffin was buried with the man still inside. In the darkness he struck a match, saw and recognized his dead friend, and realized the person he was counting on to rescue him was dead. Unable to escape, he died trapped in the buried coffin.
